ports.tooltip: Either e a — Right a (carry a) or Left e (carry error e). Unlike Maybe, the error value is preserved.
f : a ⟶ Either e b — user code; may itself return Left e
Either e b — Right b (all steps succeeded) or Left e (first error propagated, unchanged); never Either e (Either e b)
